s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v == 7]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b): out[r][c] = 3
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 7]
        for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(a + 1, b): out[r][c] = 3
    return out
''';p.write_text(s)
